caption:
Mortgage renewal Edmonton: same wall, same mortgage, about $7,000 apart in interest.
Keith Crosland & Dustin Moss · Mortgage Connection · [compliance line: TODO]

Illustrative example. Two Edmonton neighbours in one semi-detached house each have $300,000 left on a 20-year amortization, with the same bank, renewing the same month.

The left side waits for the bank's letter. Lenders only have to send it 21 days before the term ends, and if you do nothing the renewal may be automatic. They sign the first offer at 4.94%: about $1,962 a month.

The right side starts about 120 days out, asks other lenders to hold a rate and compares. At 4.44% the payment is about $1,882 a month.

That's about $80 a month. Over the 5-year term it adds up to about $7,032 more in interest, and the left side still owes about $2,235 more at the end.

Renewing in March? Day 120 is now (Nov 19 + 120 days = Mar 19).

A straight switch at renewal (same balance, same amortization) doesn't need a new stress test, but the new lender still has to approve you.

Assumptions: semi-annual compounding; the first offer is assumed to be 0.50% above the shopped rate, and your own gap may differ. 4.44% is the insured 5-year fixed reference on nesto as of Nov 19, 2026 (uninsured is 4.95%, and which applies depends on your mortgage), not an offer. Rates are 5-year fixed, before any fees, so your APR may differ. Rates change daily.

Send this to the neighbour renewing next.

whyThisClient: Keith and Dustin are Edmonton brokers who list Mortgage Renewals as a core service, and both spent years inside big banks, which is exactly where the 'first offer' comes from, so the bridge is earned from their real bios. The house is an Edmonton semi-detached, the one home type whose sales rose this October (+12.4% y/y, RAE), and every number is Edmonton or generic: no Calgary figures (kit rule r1), no Ontario tags (r2). Fills the renewal-wave window (last pandemic-era 5-year fixed renewals through mid-2027) with a sign-vs-shop story instead of the rate-prediction posts everyone else runs before Dec 9.

design.palette: Style palette, five inks + paper: paper #F4ECDD, navy #1D2340 (outlines, body, caption bar), cobalt #2E55D6 (halftone layer, SHOPPED stamp), pink #FF5A87 (misregistration shadow only), yellow #FFC628 (keyword highlight, numerals), stamp red #E8384F (party-wall line, SIGNED and verdict stamps, REC). Figures' local colours mustard and teal appear nowhere else. Kit accent is provisional, so it stays out of the print palette.
design.type: Latin build per STYLE §4 with OFL faces: black slab serif headlines, fat rounded display for numerals, heavy monospace for HUD/footnotes, black sans for captions and stamps. Two weights per family; preload all against the page text.

design.transitions: Dot wipe at 7.0 (blue), pan at 13.0, hard cut at 19.0 on the bar line, everything else in-scene.
